responsibility: Declares the PHI-cycle range-analysis API used by the GIMPLE ranger. It defines phi_group as the representation of a set of related PHI SSA names plus their modifier statement and computed range, defines phi_analyzer as the on-demand cache and discovery engine for such groups, and exposes the singleton-style phi_analysis_initialize/finalize/access entry points for clients that want SCEV-like range information about PHI recurrences.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the PHI-range pair: it defines the phi_group and phi_analyzer interfaces and the phi_analysis_* entry points for users, while gcc/gimple-range-phi.cc implements the singleton analyzer, group discovery, and range-calculation behavior.
